name: bld6_sum_choose_alternating_div_eq_beta
statement: (m n : ℕ) : ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * (n.choose k : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + k + 1) = ((m.factorial : ℝ) * n.factorial) / ((m + n + 1).factorial : ℝ)
closed: ∀ (m n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1 : ℝ) ^ k * (n.choose k : ℝ) / ((m : ℝ) + k + 1) = ((m.factorial : ℝ) * n.factorial) / ((m + n + 1).factorial : ℝ)
informal: Uses Mathlib2.calc_integral_beta_nat: expand (1-x)^n by the binomial theorem, so x^m(1-x)^n = ∑ (-1)^k C(n,k) x^(m+k); integrate termwise over [0,1] (integral_pow) to get the left side, and the right side is the value of the same integral by calc_integral_beta_nat m n (final step).
type: ∀ (m n : ℕ), ∑ k ∈ Finset.range (n + 1), (-1) ^ k * ↑(n.choose k) / (↑m + ↑k + 1) = ↑m.factorial * ↑n.factorial / ↑(m + n + 1).factorial
